caption: The drawing depicts a central female figure with long dark hair, wearing a red crown with black detailing and a geometric pattern. She is dressed in a long, brown robe with red circular and linear decorative elements and a high collar. Over the robe, she wears a black mantle that envelops her body and spreads out toward the bottom of the image. A circular, radiating halo surrounds her head. On either side of the central figure, there are two upright lit candles with red flames, each placed on a brown surface and accompanied by a red snake coiled around the base of each candle. The background is shaded in brown tones, and the entire composition is bordered by a thick, uneven black line. The color palette consists mainly of earthy browns, blacks, reds, and some off-white tones for the skin and the candles.
title: Retablo
